text:
Noah: quick heads-up from user testing — folks are getting mixed signals in the playground toolbar when switching between 'function def' and 'structured output' modes. they can't tell if the preview/run button is scoped to one function or the whole invocation.
Clara: saw that too. propose we make scope explicit in the visible label. e.g., show 'Run (selection)' vs 'Run (all)'. keep the main word short.
Diego: accessibility concerns: icon-only buttons at 16px are nearly invisible to keyboard users and lack focus indicators. suggestions: 1) add aria-labels, 2) enlarge clickable area to 24px, 3) ensure focus outline meets contrast.
Priya: implementation caveat: the toolbar lives inside the Monaco iframe. we need a small postMessage bridge to forward keyboard focus and shortcuts. adding long labels will break compact layouts. can we use a short label plus an aria-describedby tooltip for extra context?
Noah: yes — strategy: keep visible labels short ('Run', 'Preview') and append a caret when multi-scope. on focus/hover show expanded tooltip: 'Runs the selected function or all functions in this run. Shortcut: Shift+Enter.' add aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip.
Clara: also microcopy update for run history timestamps: testers read 'Ran 3s ago' as 3 seconds into the run. change finished states to 'Completed 3s ago' or 'Finished 3s ago' to avoid confusion.
Diego: run history visual state relies on color alone to show pass/fail. add an icon + small label (Success / Failed) and an aria-live region so screen readers announce status changes.
Priya: performance note: for long histories, lazy-load the SVG sprite after 50 visible items to avoid initial load cost.
Noah: copy tweak for function-def placeholder — 'args: {}' looks like a required empty object. change to 'Example args: {"email": "user@example.com"}' and a muted helper text: 'Use JSON or YAML examples.'
Clara: also propose inline validation in the editor: green check for quick lint pass, red underline + tooltip on error. reduces friction when defining functions.
ci-bot: CI: PR #5472 preview deployed to staging/playground-invoke. tests passed.
Diego: a11y follow-up — when tool-calling modal opens, focus must move to the first control and be trapped until close; Escape should close modal. I'll add focus-trap util.
Priya: i'll split this into two PRs: 1) a11y infra (aria labels, focus trap, aria-live) and message bridge; 2) copy strings, tooltips, placeholder changes, and svg lazy-load.
Noah: can we pick a copy owner to finalize wording? @Clara can you draft the final labels and tooltip strings and push to staging by EOD tomorrow? I'll run a short follow-up test.
Clara: will do. i'll post the JSON key diffs and aria strings once pushed.
Diego: i'll run axe on staging once the preview is up and post any violations.
Priya: tagging eng-runtime in case any KV cache interactions need tweak for the run-preview flow.
Noah: summary: short visible labels, explicit run scope, run history uses explicit 'Completed' wording, icons + aria-live for statuses, a11y focus traps and aria hints, copy owner @Clara, staging check by @Diego, CI green. thanks all :raised_hands:
